title: Launcher test barrier waiters wait for their owner to die instead of failing fast when a sibling process crashes
outcome: A barrier waiter in scripts/test-launcher.test.mjs (for example the notification fixture with FIXTURE_NOTIFICATION_BARRIER=4) ends promptly with a named failure when a sibling it waits for exits early. It does not wait until the test's 600 s liveness guard fires, and it still never uses a deadline.
acceptance: Launcher test barrier waiters wait for their owner to die instead of failing fast when a sibling process crashes is done
